# Randall

> Randall is a free, modern, privacy-first random video chat web application and open-source Omegle alternative. It connects users with strangers worldwide for instant 1-on-1 video calls, group video calls (up to 5 people), or anonymous text chat with zero registration required.

- **Website**: https://randall.superezz.dev
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/superezzdev/randall
- **License**: MIT
- **Primary Technologies**: React 19, Vite, WebRTC (peer-to-peer), Node.js, Express, WebSockets (`ws`), Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Arcjet security.

## Core Features

- **1-on-1 Video Chat**: Instant face-to-face random matching with WebRTC direct peer-to-peer streaming and integrated text messaging.
- **Group Video Chat**: Multi-party rooms supporting up to 5 concurrent participants.
- **Text-Only Mode**: Anonymous text chat for users without a camera or microphone.
- **Interests & Topic Matching**: Optional comma-separated tags to find like-minded strangers.
- **Zero Registration & No History**: No accounts, emails, or phone numbers needed. No chat logs or video streams stored on servers.
- **Community Safety**: Built-in instant skip, user reporting, and bot/payload protection via Arcjet and Zod.
